research_review.omitted_mechanism: A committee chair can allocate investigative staff and condition funding after a shutdown. Cruz can recruit before deciding rivals announce.
research_review.test_discrimination: Keep nomination poll, financing and organizer tests distinct. The Hegseth referral is a poor proxy for Senate conviction.
research_review.implementation_counterparty: FAA under Bryan Bedford must deliver modernization. Commerce must implement license and end-use controls. Venezuelan authorities must make appointments.
research_review.motive_alternatives: Cruz can pursue office while voicing genuine policy disagreements. Duffy’s case for resources can coexist with a defense of his agency’s performance. Donor preferences do not establish official direction.
research_review.prediction_outcomes: No terminal nomination forecast was due. Hegseth referral outcome was met. Lynch production remains unresolved.
research_review.candidate_share_sensitivity: Moving two scenario points from Cruz back to Vance under continued dissatisfaction changes the mixture by 0.60 points each. Moving ten environment points from a broad break to continued dissatisfaction raises Vance by 1.80 points; the full perturbations are in the wargame.
research_review.recall_shortfall: Screened 16 dated index entries. AP and Just Security were accessible after Memeorandum was blocked. The sample is concentrated on four roundup dates. Broad original-source verification and exact episode matching for several leads remain incomplete.
research_review.preflight_reassessment: Evidence supports the relative Cruz revision and narrower policy updates. Access gaps limit other conclusions without vetoing supported changes.
research_review.receipt_age_review: New accesses refresh the mutable AP and Just Security indexes. Historical sources are dated and used only for the claims they establish.

public_update.summary: Senator Ted Cruz’s preparations give him an opening to recruit for 2028 while Vice President JD Vance weighs when to announce. Lawmakers are also pressing Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for answers and preparing to question the Federal Aviation Administration about modernization.
public_update.privacy_screen: Screened changed research prose for owner identity, personal contact details, local paths, credentials and runtime metadata.
